svg.text: Pair pooling: one pocket region → one 312-dim vector
src/pair_pool.py, --pool_mode pairs, defaults: T = 8 learned site types, B = 8 distance bins 3–16 Å, E = 16
① One region, n surface points
② Two small heads per point
dot size = salience s_i; grey = not a site
pairs under 2 Å dropped: one atom's own point cluster
mean and mass cannot tell these two pockets apart; pairs can
through a_i, s_i, mean; not the bins
two ≠ five donors; log1p for scale
